content_text:
Hi all.
I’ve really been embracing reducing the number of lights I’ve been using lately and just augmenting practicals. Bellow are some shots from a film I shot recently.
The close up at night was one fixture as key and one household practical lamp.
The night shot of him reaching for a jar was one pocket light for key, one Aputure nova set to teal for “night room tone” and two house hold pracs.
The day shot of him standing with boxes,  no fixtures were used as key, just a window. One household prac.
The book shop scene was all one tube light as a key. I left the fluorescent house lights of the shop on.
Really finding it liberating!
